findings.question: q-biology-botany-0012
findings.quote: This mixes up the main cue for roots with the only cue. Roots respond strongly to gravity, so light can seem irrelevant to them. Check whether roots can also respond to light under some conditions.
findings.problem: The note misstates the revised distractor, which says light usually has no effect, not that gravity is the only cue. Its check does not test that claim: roots responding to light under some conditions could still be consistent with light usually having no effect. The note therefore no longer explains the actual mistake in this choice.
findings.fix: Explain that a strong response to gravity does not establish how often light affects roots. Ask whether the shoot observation gives evidence about the root response to light.
